workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 scratch process creates an ISO A3 landscape paper layout, locked rectangular 1:50 and VPCLIP polygon 1:100 viewports, paper-space title geometry, then plots through DWG To PDF.pc3, saves DWG, reopens it and plots again.
result: Native COM read-back proved both cameras, scales, locks and VPCLIP before save and after DWG reopen. Both one-page PDFs contained vector/text operators and zero image XObjects; Poppler renders were pixel-identical. AutoCAD's duplicate /PageMode catalog key is explicitly recorded by strict pypdf, while tolerant pypdf, pdfplumber and Poppler completed the read-back. The owned process terminated and the pre-existing process set was restored.
